seasons.title: Delivery Boys
seasons.arc_summary: The party takes their first courier and consultant jobs in Hallia, investigating Ugathul impersonators, Embercall's radar dishes, and the illegal augury causing perpetual rain — culminating in the discovery of Master Grayson's necromantic manor beneath the sewers.

seasons.title: The Black and White
seasons.arc_summary: A catastrophic TPK at the Crowded Flea sends the party through death and the void between worlds, where they meet the entity Aut, resurrect, and exact revenge on Hlarf — then assault Tywelwyn Leatherhide and uncover the Thessian gods' plan to crack the firmament.

seasons.title: The Pilgrimage
seasons.arc_summary: Rescuing Anaïs reveals the cosmic family called the Narrative; the party attends a mysterious pilgrimage gathering, competes in a keystone scavenger hunt, and secures passage aboard a colossal Strider bound for the Void Side Wall.

seasons.title: Cracks in the Firmament
seasons.arc_summary: During months of downtime, the party investigates a hairline fracture in reality beneath Teller's Run, uncovers a conspiracy to shatter the firmament, bombs the research facility, and departs Hallia aboard the Strider.

seasons.title: The Strider
seasons.arc_summary: Aboard the colossal walking city, the party creates a heart, navigates deadly faction politics and the weekly tithe of Voidsong energy, and descends into the Undercroft to ally with an ancient Machine God against the Herald's cultists.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: In the first session of a new Færrin-set one-shot (now a two-shot), four members of the Velvet Mark — Archie, Salvatore, Branson, and Combo — are tasked by Father Marone to assassinate the Spark, leader of the upstart gang Pyrelight. En route to Teller's Run, they're pulled over by Threshold Authority officers, leading to a violent car chase that ends with the cops' car flipped and destroyed. After ditching their identifiable car at Feathers' shop for a disguise, they sneak into Teller's Run and discover the Spark presiding over a burning-stage spectacle with a cheering crowd.

shows.name: A Hunt of Metal and Vine

seasons.title: The Joker World Expedition
seasons.arc_summary: The Cagley Middle heroes conclude their shadow-demon hunt, and four elite Scale operatives are dispatched to a shattered Joker World where they battle fiend swarms, breach the demonic installation called the Quorum, and ultimately free the trapped divine entity Voice of Many from its fiendish captors before escaping back to headquarters.

seasons.title: The Verdant Expanse
seasons.arc_summary: The convox detectives travel to Wrenford to investigate husk-murders linked to a fey stone necklace, then venture deep into the mile-tall Verdant Expanse where they rescue a lost boy, survive supernatural forest hazards, and destroy a fey court — only to learn the huskification curse continues unabated.

seasons.title: The Gloaming Codex
seasons.arc_summary: Returning to Hallia, the detectives follow fey stone leads to a jeweler's conference and uncover a ritual killer's apartment, where a cursed book called the Gloaming Codex pulls the entire party into its pages to fight for survival against carnivorous ink and cursed thoughts.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: In a one-shot set months before the main campaign, three Undercroft workers — Barlow Crane, Grant FireEye, and Gage the Cunning — investigate sabotage aboard the massive moving Strider city of Iomenei. Tracking an elven suspect named Gerhardt into a long-abandoned forsaken sector, they discover an insectoid infestation centered on a dormant engine heart cathedral and must slay a massive Swarm Hive Mother. Though they halt the infestation, the true saboteur remains at large.

seasons.title: Sedecium's Vanguard
seasons.arc_summary: A three-agent Sedecium fire team — the wizard Old Man Scrazzy, goblin gunslinger Lieutenant Foral, and orcish guardian Ozzie — investigates a slip-sunken orbital observatory uncovering a Thessian conspiracy, then undertakes a daring raid on a freshly-killed god's corpse to steal divine essence before the God Eater Harrow can finish consuming it.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: A D&D 5e one-shot set on the Finnegan Ring caravan route. Three caravan members — Mango the elven ranger, Doug Donahue the gnome rogue, and Egan the orc druid — are transported along with flautist Erin Proudcloak to a fey swampland by a mysterious mist. There, the fey creature Larunan forces them to fight for his amusement in an arena battle full of chaotic magical effects. The party survives and is returned to the caravan.
